must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

data.notes: The report got the core story right. The portal was the way in, the CFO's month-end close was the real trigger, and a value case built from her own data took the deal from 20% to won. It kept the exact dollar figure and Fiserv's pitch as unknown. Its main miss is the header: it leaves the competitor field null even though Fiserv was both the competitor and the incumbent. It also leaves the counter-reader demo and the finance-language shift out of the formal messaging changes, though both appear in the sections.
